Take-home Exercise 3: Geospatial Analytics for Urban Sustainability课后作业三：面向城市可持续发展的地理空间分析

A probabilistic spatial interaction model of MRT station ridership, and what the Jurong Region Line and Cross Island Line Phase 1 would do to it地铁车站客流的概率空间交互模型，以及裕廊区域线与跨岛线第一期带来的影响

Author

Ji Guofang

Published

November 2, 2026

Modified

November 2, 2026

This report is bilingual. Use the EN / 中文 switch at the top right of the page (or press Alt+L) to change language; the choice is remembered and carries over to the executive summary. All hand-written prose, headings, and figure and table captions are translated. Text drawn inside the figures and the cells of tables stays in English, because it is rendered by R. Variable names, function names and station names are also left in English.

本报告为中英双语。 使用页面右上角的 EN / 中文 切换按钮（或按 Alt+L）切换语言； 所选语言会被记住，并在执行摘要中保持一致。所有手写正文、标题以及图表题注都已翻译。 图形内部和表格单元格中的文字保持英文，因为它们由 R 渲染生成。变量名、函数名与车站名 同样保留英文。

Summary摘要

Singapore has opened stations a decade late because too few people stood to use them, and is about to add 29 new access points to its rail network. This report calibrates a probabilistic spatial interaction model of average daily tap-ins at the 184 stations open in August and September 2026, then uses it to predict ridership at the Jurong Region Line and Cross Island Line Phase 1 stations and the effect on those already open.

A plain Huff model fails on these data: with equal attractiveness and a distance exponent of −2, it explains less than a station’s average would (R² = −0.16). Three changes make it useful. Ridership is split by the morning balance of tap-ins and tap-outs into a home end and an activity end, each with its own market. Attractiveness depends on retail, interchange status, mode and rail time to the CBD, and not on bus stops. And the choice set stops at 5 km, because otherwise a new station in Jurong takes riders from Marina Bay. On lines left out of the calibration, the model reaches an R² of 0.67 on the log scale, against 0.45 for a direct regression on the same variables.

The new stations are predicted to carry about 225,000 tap-ins a day, with a wide range around any single station. Serangoon North, Choa Chu Kang West and Pasir Ris East lead; Aviation Park, Jurong Pier and Tengah are the likeliest to fall below Hume, the last station held back for lack of demand. Losses at existing stations fade from −22% within a kilometre of a new station to nothing beyond 8 km. They reach −59% at Pioneer. As value-added analysis, an outside option shows the data cannot separate riders diverted from riders gained, and a multiplicative competitive interaction model of OD shares shows the cost the station totals hide: about 63,000 transfers a day at Boon Lay, which has none today.

新加坡曾有车站因使用者太少而推迟十年才开放，而如今又将为铁路网增加 29 个 新进站点。本报告针对 2026 年 8、9 月开放的 184 个车站的平均每日进站量，校准一个概率 空间交互模型，再用它预测裕廊区域线与跨岛线第一期车站的客流，以及对既有车站的影响。

朴素的 Huff 模型在这份数据上是失败的：吸引力相同、距离指数取 −2 时，它的解释力还不如直接 取各站平均值（R² = −0.16）。三处改动使它变得可用。第一，依早高峰进出站的 平衡，把客流分为居住端与活动端，各有自己的市场。第二，吸引力取决于零售、换乘地位、制式与到 CBD 的 轨道时间，而与公交站数量无关。第三，选择集止于 5 公里，否则裕廊的新站会从滨海湾抢走乘客。 在校准时被留出的线路上，模型在对数尺度上的 R² 达到 0.67，而基于相同变量的 直接回归只有 0.45。

预计新站每日合计约有 225,000 次进站，单站的区间很宽。Serangoon North、 Choa Chu Kang West 与 Pasir Ris East 居前；Aviation Park、Jurong Pier 与 Tengah 最有可能低于 Hume（最近一个因需求不足而被推迟的车站）。既有车站的损失随距离衰减：距新站 1 公里内中位数为 −22%，8 公里外接近于零；Pioneer 最高，达 −59%。 作为附加价值分析，外部选项表明数据无法区分转移客流与新增客流；而基于 OD 份额的乘法竞争交互模型则显示了 车站总量所掩盖的代价：Boon Lay 今天没有换乘客流，届时每日约有 63,000 次换乘。

1 Introduction and study context引言与研究背景

Rail transit shapes a city as much as it serves one. In Singapore the MRT has linked new towns to jobs since 1987, and it is the backbone of a land-scarce, high-density plan. Building it is also a wager on future demand. A station’s structure has to go in when the line is built, years before anyone can know how many people will live around it.

The wager has not always paid promptly. Buangkok and Woodleigh were complete when the North East Line opened in June 2003, and both stayed closed for lack of development around them. Buangkok opened in January 2006 and Woodleigh in June 2011 (Wikipedia contributors, 2026a, 2026e). Hume, on the Downtown Line, was left as a structural shell because projected ridership did not justify finishing it, and it opened only in February 2025 (Wikipedia contributors, 2026b). These are not stories of bad planning. Building a shell early is cheap against building it later, and running an empty station is expensive. What the decision needs is a defensible estimate of how many people a station would serve and from where, and a clear statement of how sure that estimate is.

By 2030 two more projects will test the same judgement. The Jurong Region Line opens in stages from 2028 with 24 stations by 2029 (Land Transport Authority, 2026c). Cross Island Line Phase 1 follows in 2030 with 12 (Land Transport Authority, 2026b). Together they reach Tengah, Jurong West, Nanyang Technological University and the industrial west, and connect Pasir Ris, Hougang and Ang Mo Kio without passing through the city.

Probabilistic spatial interaction models were built for this kind of question. The Huff model treats a place as a choice among competing destinations, with the probability of each rising with its attractiveness and falling with distance (Huff, 1963). It has since been applied well beyond retail, to park-and-ride catchments (Lin et al., 2016), hospital service areas (Bai et al., 2023), store closures (Bahrami et al., 2022) and rail station catchments (Zhu et al., 2021). The last of these is closest to the present work, and differs in one way that shapes this report. Zhu et al. adopt a distance exponent of 2 and weight station attractiveness by expert opinion, rather than calibrating attractiveness against observed ridership. Singapore publishes tap-ins for every station in every hour, so here the model can be calibrated and, more usefully, tested.

轨道交通既服务城市，也塑造城市。自 1987 年以来，新加坡地铁把新市镇与就业中心连接起来，是这座土地稀缺、 高密度城市规划的骨干。但修建地铁也是对未来需求的一场押注：车站结构必须在建线时一并完成，而那时距离 人们入住周边还有很多年，谁也无法确知会有多少人住在那里。

这场押注并不总能及时兑现。东北线 2003 年 6 月开通时，Buangkok 与 Woodleigh 均已建成，却因周边缺乏 开发而继续关闭。Buangkok 于 2006 年 1 月开放，Woodleigh 则迟至 2011 年 6 月 (Wikipedia contributors, 2026a, 2026e)。滨海市区线的 Hume 因预测客流不足而只留下结构外壳，到 2025 年 2 月才开放 (Wikipedia contributors, 2026b)。这些并非规划失误的故事：提前留好结构比日后再建便宜，而运营一座空车站却很昂贵。 这类决策需要的是：对车站将服务多少人、这些人来自何处的站得住脚的估计，以及清楚说明这个估计有多可靠。

到 2030 年，又有两个项目将考验同样的判断。裕廊区域线自 2028 年起分阶段开通，到 2029 年共 24 个车站 (Land Transport Authority, 2026c)；跨岛线第一期随后于 2030 年开通，共 12 个车站 (Land Transport Authority, 2026b)。它们将通达登加、裕廊西、南洋理工 大学与西部工业区，并在不经过市区的情况下连接巴西立、后港与宏茂桥。

概率空间交互模型正是为这类问题而生。Huff 模型把一个地点视为对多个竞争目的地的选择，选择每个目的地的概率 随吸引力上升、随距离下降 (Huff, 1963)。它早已超出零售领域，被应用于停车换乘的集散范围 (Lin et al., 2016)、医院 服务区 (Bai et al., 2023)、门店关闭决策 (Bahrami et al., 2022) 以及轨道车站的集散范围 (Zhu et al., 2021)。最后这项研究与本文 最接近，但有一处差别决定了本报告的走向：Zhu 等人采用 2 作为距离指数，并以专家意见为车站吸引力加权，而不是 依据观测客流校准吸引力。新加坡公布了每个车站每小时的进站量，因此这里的模型可以校准，更重要的是可以检验。

1.1 Research questions and objectives研究问题与目标

RQ1 · Calibrate. How well can a probabilistic spatial interaction model reproduce ridership at Singapore’s stations, including stations it was not calibrated on, and what makes a station attractive once distance and competition are accounted for?

研究问题一 · 校准。 概率空间交互模型能在多大程度上复现新加坡各车站的客流，包括未参与校准的车站？在考虑 距离与竞争之后，是什么让一个车站具有吸引力？

RQ2 · Predict. What ridership can the proposed Jurong Region Line and Cross Island Line Phase 1 stations expect, how uncertain is it, and which of them risk being the next station too quiet to justify opening?

研究问题二 · 预测。 拟建的裕廊区域线与跨岛线第一期车站可望有多少客流？不确定性有多大？其中哪些有可能成为 下一个因太冷清而难以开放的车站？

RQ3 · Impact. How would the proposed stations change the ridership and market areas of stations already open, and how far from the new lines does the effect reach?

研究问题三 · 影响。 拟建车站将如何改变既有车站的客流与市场区？这种影响能从新线延伸到多远？

The value-added analysis in § 10 asks two further questions the core model cannot answer: how many of the new stations’ riders would be new to rail, and where they go once through the gate.

§ 10 的附加价值分析进一步提出核心模型无法回答的两个问题：新站的乘客中有多少是轨道交通的新用户，以及 他们进站之后去向何处。

2 Data and study design数据与研究设计

2.1 Data sources数据来源

2.2 Study design研究设计

Destinations are physical stations. Interchange codes and renumbered codes are collapsed, which gives 184 open stations, 38 of them LRT only. Origins are 500 m hexagons (flat-to-flat) holding residents, workplaces or dormitories, 1,801 in all. Each is represented by its population-weighted centre, which removes most of the error of treating a cell as a point. Distance is straight-line, in kilometres; walking networks and feeder bus routes are not modelled (see § 13).

Ridership is the average daily tap-in, over August and September 2026, with weekdays and weekends weighted as in a normal week: 2,942,323 tap-ins a day. Tap-ins count entries through a gate, so a transfer inside the paid area is not ridership at the station where it happens. This is the quantity the brief asks for, and also the main limitation of a station-level model, to which § 10 returns. Two reference points give this figure scale: 3,125,981 tap-ins on an average weekday and 2,483,177 on a weekend or holiday.

The proposed network is the brief’s: all Jurong Region Line stations opening by 2029 and Cross Island Line Phase 1. That is 36 station codes. They are not 36 new places. Seven are new codes at stations that already exist: Choa Chu Kang, Boon Lay, Jurong East, Pasir Ris, Hougang, Ang Mo Kio and Bright Hill. A passenger reaches them through the same gates as today, so they are treated as existing stations gaining a line. The other 29 are new access points. Fig. 1 shows both.

目的地是实体车站。换乘站代码与更改过的代码都被合并，得到 184 个开放车站，其中 38 个 只有轻轨。起点是 500 米的六边形（对边距离），其中有居民、工作场所或宿舍，共 1,801 个；每个六边形以人口加权中心代表，这消除了把单元当作一个点所带来的大部分误差。 距离为直线距离，单位公里；步行网络与接驳公交线路未纳入模型（见 § 13）。

客流是 2026 年 8、9 月的平均每日进站量，按正常一周的结构为工作日与周末加权：每日 2,942,323 次。进站量统计的是通过闸机的次数，因此付费区内的换乘不算发生换乘的车站的客流。 这是题目要求的量，也是车站层面模型的主要局限，§ 10 将再次讨论。两个参照点可以说明这个数字的规模： 平均工作日 3,125,981 次，周末或假日 2,483,177 次。

拟建网络按题目要求，包括 2029 年前开通的裕廊区域线全部车站与跨岛线第一期，共 36 个 车站代码。但它们并不是 36 个新地点。其中 7 个是现有车站的新代码：Choa Chu Kang、Boon Lay、 Jurong East、Pasir Ris、Hougang、Ang Mo Kio 与 Bright Hill。乘客仍通过今天的闸机进站，因此它们被视为 增加一条线路的现有车站；其余 29 个才是新的进站点。Fig. 1 显示了这两类车站。

Code 
new_pts <- dP |> filter(role == "new access point")
gain_pts <- dP |> filter(role == "existing, gains a line")
map_base(
  net_layer(), new_layer(0.9),
  geom_point(data = filter(dP, status == "open"), aes(x, y), size = 0.55, colour = "#78716c"),
  geom_point(data = new_pts, aes(x, y, fill = "New access point"), shape = 21, size = 2.1, colour = "white", stroke = .25),
  geom_point(data = gain_pts, aes(x, y, fill = "Existing station, gains a line"), shape = 23, size = 3, colour = "white", stroke = .3),
  geom_text_repel(data = gain_pts, aes(x, y, label = station_name), size = 2.7, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = .2, box.padding = .5, seed = 1)
) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_LINE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("New access point" = PAL$new, "Existing station, gains a line" = "#1d4ed8"), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = paste(AF$n_new, "new access points, and seven existing stations that gain a line"),
       subtitle = "Grey: the network open in September 2026. Teal: Jurong Region Line. Green: Cross Island Line Phase 1.") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

Most of the new stations fill gaps rather than extend the network. The Jurong Region Line weaves through the west, where most residents are already within reach of the East-West or North-South lines, and the Cross Island Line runs across the north-east through towns already served by the North East and Circle lines. The share of residents within 800 m of a station rises only from 74.2% to 81.4%, and 99.5% already live within 2 km. That makes competition with existing stations, not fresh territory, the central modelling problem.

大多数新站是在填补空隙，而不是向外延伸。 裕廊区域线在西部穿行，那里的多数居民本来就能到达东西线或南北线； 跨岛线则横穿东北部，途经已有东北线与环线服务的市镇。居住在车站 800 米范围内的居民比例只从 74.2% 升到 81.4%，而 99.5% 的居民已经住在车站 2 公里之内。因此建模的核心问题是与既有车站的竞争，而不是开拓新的地域。

3 Data preparation and quality assessment数据准备与质量评估

Preparation is carried out by scripts/01_markets.R, 02_stations.R, 03_ridership.R and 04_frames.R, reproduced in full in § 14. All of it is in SVY21 (EPSG 3414), the national projected system, in which distances are in metres. This section explains the decisions that would have changed the results, each found by checking the data rather than by reading its documentation. Tbl. 2 lists them.

数据准备由 scripts/01_markets.R、02_stations.R、03_ridership.R 与 04_frames.R 完成，全文收录于 § 14。所有处理都在新加坡的投影坐标系 SVY21（EPSG 3414）下进行，距离单位为米。本节说明那些会改变结果的决策， 它们都是通过检查数据、而不是阅读说明文档发现的。Tbl. 2 列出了这些问题。

3.1 Local market potential本地市场潜力

3.1.1 Linking dwellings to buildings把住宅单位连接到建筑

The brief recommends HDB Existing Building, but the layer has footprints and no dwellings. Dwellings are in a separate property table, whose street names do not match the layer’s street codes, and no published table links the two. The block numbers do, because a code and a name that list the same set of blocks are the same street. Block numbers repeat across the island, so overlap alone can tie (KG KAYU RD has one block, and many streets have a block of that number); the code’s letters, which abbreviate the street, break the ties.

题目推荐使用 HDB Existing Building，但该图层只有建筑轮廓，没有住宅单位数。住宅单位数在另一张房产表中，而表中的街道 名称与图层的街道代码并不对应，也没有公开的对照表。门牌号却能把二者连接起来：列出相同门牌号集合的代码与名称，就是 同一条街。门牌号在全岛会重复，所以只看重合可能出现并列（KG KAYU RD 只有一栋楼，而许多街道都有同号的楼）；代码的 字母是街名的缩写，可以用来打破并列。

The street crosswalk (from scripts/01_markets.R) 
pairs <- st_drop_geometry(bld) |>
  select(blk, ST_COD) |>
  inner_join(select(prop, blk, street), by = "blk", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  count(ST_COD, street, name = "n_common") |>
  left_join(n_cod, by = "ST_COD") |>
  left_join(n_str, by = "street") |>
  mutate(jaccard = n_common / (n_cod + n_str - n_common),   # overlap of the two block sets
         letters = mapply(prefix_score, ST_COD, street),    # do the code's letters fit the name?
         score   = jaccard + 0.5 * letters) |>
  arrange(desc(score), desc(n_common))
# ...then a one-to-one assignment, best pair first.
ST_COD street n_common n_cod n_str jaccard
YIR00Z YISHUN RING RD 163 163 163 1.00
BER00B BEDOK RESERVOIR RD 133 133 133 1.00
ANA03L ANG MO KIO AVE 10 104 104 104 1.00
PUF02Z PUNGGOL FIELD 103 103 103 1.00
WOS18M WOODLANDS SQ 2 2 7 0.29
TEA09T TENGAH GDN AVE 21 21 45 0.47

The crosswalk assigns 656 of 660 street codes, 635 of them with identical block sets (Jaccard 1), which leaves little room for coincidence; the table shows the largest matches and the two weakest. The weak ones are streets that gained blocks after the footprint layer was revised, such as Tengah Garden Avenue. The four unassigned codes hold 120 footprints with no property record, and none is a block with dwellings. Every residential block without a footprint was completed in 2026.

对照表为 660 个街道代码中的 656 个找到了匹配，其中 635 个的门牌号集合完全相同 （Jaccard 为 1），偶然巧合的余地很小；表中列出了最大的匹配和最弱的两个。较弱的是建筑图层更新后又增加了楼栋的街道，例如 Tengah Garden Avenue。4 个未匹配代码共有 120 个没有房产记录的建筑，其中没有含住宅单位的楼。 所有没有建筑轮廓的住宅楼都是 2026 年竣工的。

3.1.2 Placing residents定位居民

Dwellings are not people, and HDB is not everyone. The June 2024 population table gives residents by subzone and dwelling type, 4,189,460 in all. HDB residents are spread over blocks within each subzone and flat type, so a subzone’s four-room residents go to its four-room flats. Blocks completed after the reference date receive the island-wide figure for their type (from 1.68 persons a flat for one- and two-room flats to 3.34 for five-room and executive flats), because the ridership being modelled dates from 2026.

Residents of condominiums and landed houses, 23.4% of the total, are placed on OpenStreetMap buildings: apartments by footprint and houses by count, within each subzone, after removing 12,906 OSM buildings that are HDB blocks. 99.3% of them land on buildings of the right type. Allocated residents total 4,242,280, the official count plus the estimate for new blocks, by construction. Planning-area totals correlate with the official ones at 0.9996. Because residents are allocated within subzones, that shows nothing was lost, not that everyone was placed on the right building. The largest gap is the intended one: Tengah has 17,671 residents against 8,080 in June 2024, because most of its flats are newer than the count. Fig. 2 maps the result.

住宅单位不等于人，HDB 也不等于所有人。2024 年 6 月的人口表按分区与住宅类型给出居民数，合计 4,189,460 人。 HDB 居民在每个分区内按房型分配到各楼栋，也就是一个分区的四房式居民被分到该分区的四房式单位。人口基准日之后竣工的 楼栋则采用全岛同类房型的平均数（从一、二房式每户 1.68 人到五房式与公寓式每户 3.34 人），因为所建模的客流来自 2026 年。

居住在共管公寓与有地住宅的居民占 23.4%，他们被分配到 OpenStreetMap 建筑上：在每个分区内，公寓按 占地面积、独立住宅按栋数，并先剔除 12,906 栋实为 HDB 组屋的 OSM 建筑。其中 99.3% 落在类型正确的建筑上。分配后的居民合计 4,242,280 人，这一总数按构造就等于官方人口加上新楼栋的估计数。规划区总量与官方数字的相关系数为 0.9996。 由于居民是在小区内部分配的，这只说明没有遗漏，并不说明每个人都被安置到了正确的建筑上。最大的差距正是有意为之：登加有 17,671 名居民，而 2024 年 6 月的数字为 8,080，因为那里的大多数组屋都比这次统计更新。Fig. 2 显示了结果。

3.1.3 Markets that are not homes不是住所的市场

A station also fills from places where people are not at home. Two activity columns come from OpenStreetMap: footprint area of 8,381 workplace buildings (offices, shops, factories, schools, hospitals) and a count of 21,388 points of interest, with street furniture such as benches and vending machines left out. Dormitories get a column of their own (439 buildings): their occupants are mostly foreign workers and students, who are outside the resident count but very much on the trains. OSM has no building heights, so footprint understates the tall offices of the CBD, a bias discussed in § 6.

车站的客流也来自人们不在家的地方。OpenStreetMap 提供了两个活动字段：8,381 栋工作场所建筑（办公楼、商店、工厂、 学校、医院）的占地面积，以及 21,388 个兴趣点的数量，其中剔除了长椅、自动售货机之类的街道设施。宿舍单独设一个 字段（439 栋）：其住户多为外籍劳工与学生，不在居民统计之内，却是地铁的常客。OSM 没有建筑高度，所以占地面积低估了 CBD 高层办公楼，§ 6 将讨论这一偏差。

Code 
hm <- function(col, title, trans = "sqrt", lab = waiver(), br = waiver()) {
  map_base(
    geom_sf(data = filter(hex, .data[[col]] > 0), aes(fill = .data[[col]]), colour = NA),
    net_layer("#44403c", .18)
  ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = RAMP_SEQ, trans = trans, labels = lab, breaks = br, name = NULL) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"), legend.key.height = unit(.25, "cm"))
}
hm("residents", "Residents", lab = comma) + hm("work_m2", "Workplace footprint (m²)", lab = comma, br = c(20000, 75000, 150000))

Homes and activity sit in different places, which a single market cannot represent. Residents fill a ring of new towns, from Woodlands round through Punggol to Tampines and across to Jurong West. Workplace footprint concentrates in Jurong, Tuas and the northern industrial estates, far from those towns. The CBD barely registers on the right-hand map, despite being the country’s largest employment centre, which is the height bias at work. Both facts shape the model. A station’s ridership cannot be explained by one market, and this measure of activity is better at saying where activity is than how much of it there is.

住所与活动分布在不同地方，单一市场无法表示。 居民集中在一圈新市镇：从兀兰经榜鹅到淡滨尼，再到裕廊西。工作场所占地 则集中在裕廊、大士与北部工业区，远离这些市镇。CBD 虽是全国最大的就业中心，在右图中却几乎看不出来，这正是高度偏差的 表现。这两点都影响建模：车站的客流无法用单一市场解释，而这个活动指标更善于说明活动在哪里，而不是有多少。

3.2 Observed ridership观测客流

A node code can name an interchange (“NS24/NE6/CC1”), and three stations appear under two. Circle Line Stage 6 opened on 12 July 2026 (Land Transport Authority, 2026a) and renumbered Marina Bay and Bayfront (CE2 to CC33, CE1 to CC34), so both spellings are in the July file; Stevens is reported as separate nodes for its two lines. After merging, 187 node codes give 184 stations, each of which appears in the data. Thomson-East Coast Line Stage 5 and Downtown Line Stage 3e do not appear, so they had not opened by September, and they are left out of both networks (Land Transport Authority, 2026d).

Monthly totals mislead because the calendar differs: on the face of it August’s weekdays carry 12% fewer tap-ins than July’s, but August has 20 weekdays and July 23. Per day, the two months are within 1.4% of each other (Tbl. 3). The months also agree closely station by station: August and September weekday ridership correlate at 0.998 on the log scale, and the median station moves by 3.1%.

节点代码可以表示一个换乘站（“NS24/NE6/CC1”），而有三个车站以两个节点出现。环线第六期于 2026 年 7 月 12 日开通 (Land Transport Authority, 2026a)，并为滨海湾与海湾舫重新编号（CE2 改为 CC33，CE1 改为 CC34），所以 7 月的文件中两种写法都有；Stevens 则按 两条线路分别报告为两个节点。合并之后，187 个节点代码对应 184 个车站，每个车站都出现在数据中。 汤东线第五期与滨海市区线 3e 期没有出现，说明到 9 月尚未开通，因此两个网络都不包含它们 (Land Transport Authority, 2026d)。

月度总量具有误导性，因为日历不同：表面上 8 月工作日的进站量比 7 月少 12%，但 8 月只有 20 个工作日，7 月有 23 个。 按日计算，两个月相差不超过 1.4%（Tbl. 3）。各月在单站层面也高度一致：8、9 月工作日客流在对数尺度上的相关系数为 0.998，单站变动的中位数为 3.1%。

The reference period is August and September. July is left out, because Stage 6 has a partial month in it and the rest of the network was still adjusting to a closed circle. The OD file falls short of the station file because it records only completed journeys, and a tap-in with no matching tap-out cannot be in it, so the station file is the source of observed ridership and the OD file is used only for destination shares.

基准期取 8、9 月。7 月被排除，因为其中第六期只有部分月份，而全网也还在适应环线闭合。OD 文件的总量低于车站文件，因为它只 记录完整的行程，没有对应出站的进站不会出现在其中，所以观测客流取自车站文件，OD 文件只用于目的地份额。

3.3 Attraction variables吸引力变量

Attraction variables are measured the same way for existing and proposed stations, because a proposed station has nothing else to be predicted from. They are the number of bus stops, retail and service points of interest, and food points of interest within 400 m; whether a station has only LRT; how many lines beyond the first it has; and rail time to Raffles Place. The last comes from a graph of the network, with distance over an assumed running speed (35 km/h for MRT, 30 for the Jurong Region Line, 20 for LRT, including stops) and a 5-minute penalty for each change. It has to be recalculated for the proposed network, because the new lines shorten it for some existing stations.

吸引力变量在既有车站与拟建车站上按同样方式测量，因为拟建车站没有其他依据可供预测。它们包括 400 米内的公交站数量、零售与 服务类兴趣点数量、餐饮类兴趣点数量；车站是否只有轻轨；除第一条线路外还有几条线路；以及到 Raffles Place 的轨道时间。最后一项来自 铁路网图：距离除以假定的运行速度（地铁 35 公里/小时、裕廊区域线 30、轻轨 20，均已包含停站），每次换乘加 5 分钟。拟建网络下需要 重新计算，因为新线缩短了部分既有车站的这一时间。

3.4 The data frames the brief asks for题目要求的数据框

Four tables come out of preparation. The two interaction frames share their column names, as MCI’s functions require: si_existing has 331,384 origin-destination pairs and si_proposed has 383,613. origins holds the local market potential and dest_existing the observed ridership and attraction variables. The attractiveness columns are filled in after calibration.

数据准备产生四张表。两个交互数据框的列名相同，这是 MCI 函数的要求：si_existing 有 331,384 对起讫点， si_proposed 有 383,613 对。origins 保存本地市场潜力，dest_existing 保存观测客流与吸引力变量。 吸引力列在校准后填入。

Code 
si_e |> filter(in_range) |> slice_sample(n = 3)
Code 
si_p |> filter(destination %in% NT$destination, in_range) |> slice_sample(n = 3)
Code 
origins |> select(origin, residents, res_private, hdb_du, dorm_m2, work_m2, poi) |> slice_max(residents, n = 3)
Code 
dE |> select(destination, station_name, daily_in, phi, T_H, T_W, bus_400, retail_400, food_400, lrt, ic, min_cbd) |>
  slice_max(daily_in, n = 3)

4 Analytical assumptions and methodological decisions分析假设与方法决策

4.1 The model模型

For origin \(i\) and station \(j\), the Huff probability (Huff, 1963) with a multiplicative attractiveness is

对起点 \(i\) 与车站 \(j\)，采用乘法形式吸引力的 Huff 概率 (Huff, 1963) 为

\[ P_{ij} = \frac{A_j\, d_{ij}^{\,\lambda}}{\sum_{k:\, d_{ik} \le D} A_k\, d_{ik}^{\,\lambda}}, \qquad A_j = \exp\!\Big(\sum_m \beta_m x_{jm}\Big), \qquad E_j = \sum_i M_i\, P_{ij}, \]

where \(M_i\) is the local market, \(x_{jm}\) the attraction variables, \(\lambda\) the distance exponent and \(D\) a maximum access distance. It is calibrated separately for two purposes, and the expected ridership is their sum:

其中 \(M_i\) 为本地市场，\(x_{jm}\) 为吸引力变量，\(\lambda\) 为距离指数，\(D\) 为最大到达距离。模型按两种出行目的分别校准，预期客流是 两者之和：

\[ T_j^{H} = \phi_j T_j, \qquad T_j^{W} = (1-\phi_j) T_j, \qquad \phi_j = \frac{\text{AM tap-ins}_j}{\text{AM tap-ins}_j + \text{AM tap-outs}_j}. \]

Parameters are found by minimising squared log errors, \(\sum_j (\log T_j - \log E_j)^2\). Ridership runs from under 200 to about 70,000 a day, and the stations this exercise cares about most are at the bottom of that range; on the raw scale the fit would be decided by a dozen interchanges. The calibration uses exact gradients in matrix form (R/huff.R), because the validation and bootstrap need thousands of calibrations. § 6.5 confirms that it gives what MCI::huff.shares() gives (Wieland, 2017).

参数通过最小化对数误差平方和 \(\sum_j (\log T_j - \log E_j)^2\) 求得。客流从每日不足 200 到约 70,000 不等，而本研究最关心的车站 都处在这个范围的底部；若用原始尺度，拟合结果将由十几个换乘站决定。校准以矩阵形式使用精确梯度（R/huff.R），因为验证与自助法 需要进行数千次校准。§ 6.5 确认其结果与 MCI::huff.shares() 的结果相同 (Wieland, 2017)。

4.2 Decisions决策

4.3 Why two purposes为什么区分两种目的

The Huff model describes people at an origin choosing a destination, and the obvious origin of a rail trip is home. That works for a morning tap-in at Buangkok. It does not work for an evening tap-in at Raffles Place, whose rider lives somewhere else entirely. A single model of all tap-ins has no way to say this: to explain Raffles Place’s 52,878 daily tap-ins, it must assign it residents from across the island, and those long reaches are what later let a station in Jurong take riders from the CBD. Splitting ridership by the morning balance gives each kind of trip an origin it could plausibly start from. It is an approximation: the morning balance is not the whole day’s, and a station’s visitors are not all commuters. It is, however, directly observed for every station, and it reads as it should (Fig. 3).

Huff 模型描述的是某个起点的人选择目的地，而轨道出行最明显的起点是家。这适用于 Buangkok 的早晨进站，却不适用于 Raffles Place 的傍晚进站，因为这位乘客住在完全不同的地方。单一的全量进站模型无法表达这一点：为了解释 Raffles Place 每日 52,878 次进站，它只能把全岛各地的居民都分配给这个车站，而正是这种过远的辐射，使裕廊的车站后来能从 CBD 抢走 乘客。按早高峰的平衡拆分客流，使每类出行都有一个合理的起点。这只是近似：早高峰的平衡不等于全天的平衡，车站的访客也不都是通勤者。 但这个量对每个车站都是直接观测到的，而且结果也符合常理（Fig. 3）。

5 Ridership today当前客流

Code 
lab <- dE |> filter(station_name %in% c("Jurong East", "Raffles Place", "Orchard", "Woodlands", "Tampines", "Buangkok",
                                        "Keppel", "Hume", "Tuas Link", "Changi Airport", "Kent Ridge", "Punggol"))
map_base(
  net_layer(),
  geom_point(data = dE, aes(x, y, size = daily_in, fill = phi), shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = .2),
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(x, y, label = station_name), size = 2.6, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = .2, seed = 2, box.padding = .35)
) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 8, breaks = c(1000, 10000, 30000, 60000), labels = comma, name = "Daily tap-ins",
                  guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "#a8a29e", colour = "#78716c"))) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#b2182b", "#f4a582", "#f7f7f7", "#92c5de", "#2166ac"), limits = c(0, 1),
                       labels = percent, name = "Home share") +
  labs(title = "Where ridership is, and what kind it is",
       subtitle = "Blue stations fill from homes in the morning. Red stations fill from people arriving, and empty at night.") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

Stations split cleanly into places people leave and places people go. Home share runs from 3.2% at Shenton Way to 89.6% at Rumbia. The CBD, one-north, Kent Ridge and the Tuas estates are red: their tap-ins are people leaving work. The heartland towns are blue. Half of all tap-ins (49.8%) fall on the home side, which is what round trips would produce. Size says something different from colour: Jurong East, a red-tinted interchange, is the busiest station at 69,304 tap-ins a day, and big blue stations such as Punggol and Tampines fill mostly from homes. This split is what the calibration uses.

车站清楚地分为人们离开的地方和人们前往的地方。 居住端比例从 Shenton Way 的 3.2% 到 Rumbia 的 89.6%。CBD、纬壹、肯特岗与大士工业区呈红色：其进站者是下班离开的人；组屋区市镇呈蓝色。 全部进站量的一半（49.8%）落在居住端，这正是往返出行应有的结果。大小传达的信息与颜色不同： Jurong East 这个偏红的换乘站是最繁忙的车站，每日 69,304 次；而榜鹅、淡滨尼这些大型蓝色车站主要来自住所。校准使用的正是这种拆分。

Code 
ranked <- dE |> arrange(desc(daily_in)) |> mutate(rank = row_number(), mode = ifelse(lrt == 1, "LRT only", "MRT"))
lab <- ranked |> filter(station_name %in% c("Jurong East", "Buangkok", "Woodleigh", "Hume", "Keppel", "Teck Lee",
                                            "Cantonment", "Prince Edward Road")) |>
  mutate(nx = case_when(station_name == "Jurong East" ~ 8, station_name == "Hume" ~ -14, TRUE ~ 0),
         ny = case_when(station_name == "Jurong East" ~ -.42, station_name == "Hume" ~ -.3, TRUE ~ 0))
ggplot(ranked, aes(rank, daily_in, colour = mode)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = SC$LOW20, linetype = 3, colour = PAL$grey) +
  annotate("text", x = 180, y = SC$LOW20 * 1.2, label = "Lowest fifth of MRT stations", hjust = 1, size = 2.8, colour = PAL$grey) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = station_name), size = 2.9, colour = PAL$ink, seed = 3,
                  nudge_x = lab$nx, nudge_y = lab$ny, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = .2, box.padding = .5) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = comma) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("LRT only" = "#a8a29e", MRT = PAL$rail), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Rank", y = "Daily tap-ins (log scale)") +
  theme_th(10)

Stations once kept shut can do very well, and a new one can still be nearly empty. Buangkok carries 23,662 tap-ins a day and Woodleigh 15,503, both comfortably above the MRT median of 13,844. Hume, 18 months after opening, has 2,239, and only three MRT stations are lower. Keppel is the extreme case: open since July, it records 174 a day, about a four-hundredth of Jurong East, because the Greater Southern Waterfront it was built to serve has not arrived (Wikipedia contributors, 2026c). Ridership at a station says less about the station than about what has been built around it, and that is the limit of any forecast made from land use today.

曾被关闭的车站可以表现很好，而新车站也可能几乎无人使用。 Buangkok 每日 23,662 次进站，Woodleigh 15,503 次， 都明显高于地铁车站中位数 13,844。Hume 开放 18 个月后只有 2,239 次，只有三个地铁车站比它更低。 Keppel 是极端例子：7 月开放至今，每日只有 174 次，是 Jurong East 的约四百分之一，因为它要服务的大南部水岸尚未建成 (Wikipedia contributors, 2026c)。 车站的客流与其说反映车站本身，不如说反映周围已经建成了什么，而这正是任何基于当前土地利用的预测的局限。

6 Calibrating the model校准模型

6.1 From a reference model upwards从参照模型逐步建立

Models are built up from simple reference points, and each is scored twice. The in-sample R² on the log scale says how well it describes the stations it was calibrated on. The hold-out score says more: each line in turn has its stations removed from the network, the model is calibrated without them, they are then added back as if newly built, and their ridership is predicted. A station stays out only if it serves no other line, which gives nine folds and 155 held-out stations. This is the closest available imitation of the real task.

模型从简单的参照点逐步建立，每个模型都打两个分数。对数尺度上的样本内 R² 说明它对参与校准的车站描述得如何。留出分数更能说明问题： 依次把每条线路的车站从网络中移除，在没有它们的情况下校准模型，再把它们当作新建车站加回去并预测其客流。只有不服务其他线路的车站才会被留出， 这样共有九折、155 个留出车站。这是对真实任务最接近的模拟。

Code 
lt <- LT |>
  mutate(model = fct_rev(fct_inorder(model)),
         selected = grepl("selected", model))
ggplot(lt, aes(y = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = pmax(lolo_r2, -.5), xend = pmax(insample, -.5), yend = model), colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_point(aes(x = pmax(insample, -.5), colour = "In sample"), size = 2.4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = pmax(lolo_r2, -.5), colour = "Line held out"), size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(aes(x = pmax(lolo_r2, -.5), label = sprintf("%.2f", lolo_r2)), hjust = 1.4, size = 2.7, colour = PAL$new) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("In sample" = "#a8a29e", "Line held out" = PAL$new), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-.62, .85)) +
  labs(x = "R² on the log scale", y = NULL) +
  theme_th(10) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

Distance alone explains nothing here, and the climb comes from three separate ideas. Assigning everyone to their nearest station (M0) is far worse than guessing the mean. A Huff model with equal attractiveness and the conventional exponent of −2 (M1) still falls below zero, and if its exponent is left free it drifts to 0.18, a positive value that makes no behavioural sense. The reason is that attractiveness differs enormously: the median LRT station carries about a fifth of the median MRT station’s tap-ins, often in the same dense towns. Adding mode and interchange (M3) reaches 0.43 on held-out lines, the surrounding retail and food 0.54, and non-residential markets 0.66. Treating the two ends of a trip separately and adding rail time (M6, M7) brings the score to 0.71.

The selected model (M8) then gives some of that back, to 0.67, for the reason §6.2 sets out. Even so, it clearly beats a direct regression on the same variables, at 0.45, although the regression holds its own in sample (0.65). Competition between stations matters most when predicting stations that did not exist during calibration.

单靠距离在这里什么也解释不了，提升来自三个不同的思路。 把每个人分配给最近车站（M0）比直接猜平均值差得多。吸引力相同、取常规指数 −2 的 Huff 模型（M1）仍低于零；若放开指数，它会漂移到 0.18，这个正值在行为上毫无意义。原因是吸引力差异极大：轻轨车站进站量的中位数只有地铁车站的约五分之一，而它们常常位于同样密集的市镇。 加入制式与换乘（M3）后，留出线路上的分数达到 0.43，加入周边零售与餐饮后为 0.54，加入非居住市场后为 0.66。 把出行两端分开处理并加入轨道时间（M6、M7），分数升到 0.71。

入选模型（M8）则退回到 0.67，原因见 §6.2。即便如此，它仍明显优于基于相同变量的直接回归（0.45），尽管回归在样本内表现尚可（0.65）。 在预测校准时不存在的车站时，车站之间的竞争最为重要。

Power decay beats exponential decay on held-out lines (0.67 against 0.63). Fixing the exponent at −2, as Zhu et al. do (Zhu et al., 2021), costs little (0.64), and −2 sits inside the home-end confidence interval, so that convention is supported for access from home. It is not supported for the activity end, where the data favour something flatter. The activity market is the weak part of the model, as § 6.3 shows.

在留出线路上，幂函数衰减优于指数衰减（0.67 对 0.63）。像 Zhu 等人那样把指数固定为 −2 (Zhu et al., 2021) 的代价很小（0.64），而且 −2 落在居住端的置信区间内，所以这个惯例 对从家出发的到达过程是成立的。但它对活动端不成立，那里的数据支持更平缓的衰减。活动市场是模型的薄弱环节，§ 6.3 会说明这一点。

6.2 The best score is not the best model分数最高的并非最好的模型

A model with no limit on access distance scores best on held-out lines, and that score is partly false comfort. With a power decay, a hexagon in Jurong keeps a small probability of using Raffles Place, 20 km away. Multiplied across the whole island, those small probabilities are how the model finds Raffles Place’s ridership, and they mean a new station in Jurong takes riders from the CBD. A plausibility test that the hold-out score cannot supply is what happens at stations more than 8 km from any new station. They should not change. Fig. 6 shows both quantities as the maximum access distance varies.

不限制到达距离的模型在留出线路上得分最高，但这个分数部分是虚假的安慰。在幂函数衰减下，裕廊的一个六边形仍保留一个小概率去使用 20 公里外的 Raffles Place。这些小概率累积到全岛，正是模型找到 Raffles Place 客流的方式，也意味着裕廊的新站会从 CBD 抢走乘客。留出分数无法提供的一个合理性检验，是看距任何新站 8 公里以上 的车站会发生什么：它们本不应变化。Fig. 6 显示了这两个量随最大到达距离变化的情况。

Code 
pd <- RP$prof_dmax |> mutate(lab = ifelse(is.finite(dmax), paste0(dmax, " km"), "None"), lab = fct_inorder(lab),
                             sel = dmax == RP$DMAX)
p1 <- ggplot(pd, aes(lab, lolo, group = 1)) + geom_line(colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = sel), size = 2.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", lolo)), vjust = -1, size = 2.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = PAL$new, `FALSE` = PAL$grey)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(.58, .74)) +
  labs(x = "Maximum access distance", y = "Held-out R²") + theme_th(10)
p2 <- ggplot(pd, aes(lab, far_median, group = 1)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = PAL$grey_l) + geom_line(colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = sel), size = 2.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(abs(far_median) < .0005, "0%", chg(far_median, 1))), vjust = 1.9, size = 2.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = PAL$new, `FALSE` = PAL$grey)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(-.13, .01)) +
  labs(x = "Maximum access distance", y = "Median change beyond 8 km") + theme_th(10)
p1 + p2

The limit trades a little fit for a result that can be believed. With no limit, stations more than 8 km from anything new change by a median of −10%. That effect has no plausible mechanism. It comes from the tail of the decay. A 5 km limit removes it, at a cost of 0.04 in held-out R², and beyond that the score is nearly flat until 12 km. Five kilometres is also generous on its own terms: 99.96% of residents live within 3 km of a station, and a feeder bus covers the rest. Limits of 3 km and no limit are carried through §9.4, so the choice can be judged by its consequences.

这个限制用一点拟合度换来了可信的结果。 不设限制时，距任何新站 8 公里以上的车站变化中位数为 −10%。这种效应没有合理的机制，只来自衰减函数的尾部。 5 公里的限制消除了它，代价是留出 R² 下降 0.04，再往上直到 12 公里，分数几乎持平。五公里本身也已足够宽松：99.96% 的居民住在车站 3 公里以内， 其余可由接驳公交覆盖。3 公里与不设限制这两种情形都保留到 §9.4，可以从后果来判断这一选择。

6.3 What makes a station attractive是什么让车站具有吸引力

Code 
term_lab <- c(lambda = "Distance exponent", l_bus = "Bus stops (log)", l_ret = "Retail and services (log)", l_food = "Food (log)",
              lrt = "LRT only", ic = "Each extra line", l_cbd = "Rail time to CBD (log)")
cf <- bind_rows(mutate(RP$coef_H, part = "Home end"), mutate(RP$coef_W, part = "Activity end")) |>
  filter(term %in% names(term_lab)) |>
  mutate(term = factor(term_lab[term], levels = rev(term_lab)), part = factor(part, c("Home end", "Activity end")))
ggplot(cf, aes(estimate, term, colour = part)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(width = .55), size = .35, linewidth = .6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Home end" = "#2166ac", "Activity end" = "#b2182b"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Estimate", y = NULL) +
  theme_th(10)

Interchange status, mode, retail and connection to the city matter; bus stops do not. Mode has the largest effect: an LRT-only station has 7% of the home-end pull of an MRT station with the same surroundings. Each extra line multiplies the pull by about 1.7. Doubling the retail nearby raises it by about 27%. Doubling rail time to the CBD cuts it by about 28%, which is the data-driven counterpart of Zhu et al.’s in-vehicle time. The number of bus stops, recommended in the brief, has an interval spanning zero at both ends once retail is in the model; bus stops are almost everywhere and vary little (the middle half of stations have between 6 and 12). The food count is likewise unsupported.

Home-end access decays steeply at −2.11. The activity-end exponent, −0.99, is much flatter and its interval reaches zero, so distance from a workplace to a station is poorly determined. This is a limit of OSM footprints: they cannot say how much activity a tall office holds.

换乘地位、制式、零售与通往市区的连接重要，公交站数量则不然。 制式的影响最大：纯轻轨车站在居住端的吸引力只有周边条件相同的地铁车站的 7%。每多一条线路，吸引力约变为 1.7 倍。周边零售加倍，吸引力约上升 27%。到 CBD 的轨道时间加倍，吸引力约下降 28%，这是 Zhu 等人车内时间的数据驱动对应物。 题目推荐的公交站数量，在模型纳入零售后，两端的区间都跨过了零；公交站几乎无处不在，变化很小（中间一半车站有 6 到 12 个）。餐饮数量同样得不到支持。

居住端的到达过程衰减很陡，指数为 −2.11。活动端的指数为 −0.99，平缓得多，且区间触及零，所以工作地点到车站的距离作用难以确定。这是 OSM 占地面积的局限：它无法说明一栋高层办公楼里容纳了多少活动。

Against a null. A flexible model can find apparent patterns in noise, so the bus, retail and food counts were shuffled among stations of the same mode 99 times, breaking only their link to ridership. The observed in-sample R² of 0.755 exceeds all 99 shuffled fits, whose maximum is 0.716 (p = 0.01). The null’s average, 0.700, is itself high, because the markets, mode, interchange status and rail time remain in place and do most of the work.

与零模型比较。 灵活的模型可能从噪声中找到表面的规律，所以把公交、零售与餐饮的数量在同一制式的车站之间打乱 99 次，只切断它们与客流的联系。样本内 R² 的观测值 0.755 超过了 全部 99 次打乱的结果，其最大值为 0.716（p = 0.01）。零模型的均值 0.700 本身也很高，因为市场、制式、换乘地位与轨道时间都还保留，它们完成了大部分工作。

6.4 How well it predicts unseen lines对未见线路的预测效果

Code 
rt <- RP$residuals_tbl |> filter(!is.na(fold)) |>
  mutate(group = ifelse(grepl("LRT", fold), "LRT lines", paste(fold, "line")), err = lolo / daily_in)
lab <- rt |> filter(abs(log(err)) > log(2.6) | station_name %in% c("Hume"))
ggplot(rt, aes(lolo, daily_in)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = 2, colour = PAL$grey) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = c(log10(2), -log10(2)), linetype = 3, colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = group), size = 1.8, alpha = .85) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = station_name), size = 2.6, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = .2, seed = 4) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma) + scale_y_log10(labels = comma) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("NS line" = "#d42e12", "EW line" = "#009645", "NE line" = "#9900aa", "CC line" = "#fa9e0d",
                                 "DT line" = "#005ec4", "TE line" = "#9d5b25", "LRT lines" = "#a8a29e"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Predicted with the line held out", y = "Actual") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_th(10)

Roughly right on a log scale, with most stations within a factor of two. Rank correlation on held-out stations is 0.86 and the median absolute error is 35%. Line totals are usually within about a third of the actual (Tbl. 6): the Thomson-East Coast Line, the newest line and the best analogue for a new line in a built-up city, comes out at 1.06 times its actual total. The misses are informative. Stations far above the line, such as Kranji and Downtown, seem to draw on something other than what surrounds them, perhaps the Causeway in Kranji’s case. The model is too generous at the very bottom: Keppel and Teck Lee are overpredicted several times over, because nothing it can see distinguishes a station beside an empty site from one beside a modest neighbourhood.

As a screen for low ridership it is still useful. On held-out MRT stations, the chance that a station in the lowest fifth is ranked below one that is not is 0.87 (AUC).

在对数尺度上大体正确，多数车站在两倍范围内。 留出车站的秩相关为 0.86，绝对误差中位数为 35%。线路总量与实际的差距通常不超过约三分之一（Tbl. 6）：汤东线是最新的线路，也是建成区新线的最佳参照，预测总量是实际的 1.06 倍。偏差也很有信息量。远高于对角线的车站，如 Kranji 与 Downtown，似乎依赖周边环境之外的因素，Kranji 可能是因为长堤。而在最底部，模型又过于乐观： Keppel 与 Teck Lee 被高估了数倍，因为模型所能看到的信息无法区分位于空地旁的车站和位于普通社区旁的车站。

作为低客流的筛查工具，它仍然有用。在留出的地铁车站中，最低五分之一车站排在其他车站之下的概率为 0.87（AUC）。

6.5 Against MCI与 MCI 对照

The calibration runs on matrices, so it needs checking against the package the course uses. huff.shares() and shares.total() in MCI (Wieland, 2017) were run on the interaction frame with the selected home-end attractiveness and exponent. Both need a complete rectangular table, so a station out of range is set to an extremely large distance rather than removed, which sends its share to zero. On 315,744 rows the largest difference from the matrix form is 1.8e-11 tap-ins, which is rounding. One evaluation took 7 minutes against a small fraction of a second, and calibrating needs thousands of them, which is why the matrix form is used. huff.fit() is not used for the final model, for a different reason, given in §9.4.

校准是在矩阵上运行的，所以需要与课程所用的程序包对照。把入选的居住端吸引力与指数代入交互数据框，运行 MCI (Wieland, 2017) 中的 huff.shares() 与 shares.total()。两者都需要完整的矩形表，所以超出范围的车站不是被移除， 而是被设为极大的距离，使其份额趋于零。在 315,744 行上，与矩阵形式的最大差距为 1.8e-11 次进站，这只是舍入误差。一次计算需要 7 分钟，而矩阵形式只需不到一秒，校准却需要数千次计算， 这就是使用矩阵形式的原因。最终模型没有采用 huff.fit()，理由不同，见 §9.4。

7 Ridership estimated at existing stations既有车站的客流估计

Applied to the stations it was calibrated on, the selected model gives an R² of 0.75 on the log scale and a rank correlation of 0.89. Fig. 9 maps what it misses. Each station’s residual is the log of observed over estimated ridership, so a value of 0.7 means it carries about twice what the model expects.

应用于参与校准的车站时，入选模型在对数尺度上的 R² 为 0.75，秩相关为 0.89。Fig. 9 显示了它遗漏的部分。每个车站的残差是观测客流与估计客流之比的对数，所以 0.7 表示它的客流约为模型预期的两倍。

Code 
rs <- RP$residuals_tbl
lab <- bind_rows(slice_max(rs, resid, n = 9), slice_min(rs, resid, n = 8))
map_base(
  net_layer(),
  geom_point(data = rs, aes(x, y, fill = resid, size = abs(resid)), shape = 21, colour = "#78716c", stroke = .15),
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(x, y, label = station_name), size = 2.6, min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = .2,
                  seed = 5, box.padding = .4, max.overlaps = 40)
) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = RAMP_DIV, limits = c(-2.4, 2.4), name = "log(observed\n/ estimated)") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(.8, 4.5), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "What attractiveness and local markets cannot explain")

The misses point to reasons the data do not record. Above expectation: Bayfront (6.3 times its estimate), Kranji, HarbourFront, Downtown, Newton, Novena and Somerset. Below it: Keppel, Teck Lee, Petir, Marina Bay and Hume. One can suggest a story for several, such as a resort, a ferry terminal or a land checkpoint, but those are guesses. A model limited to retail counts and footprints has no way to test them. Some of this is spatially organised: Moran’s I on the residuals, with six nearest stations as neighbours, is 0.18 (p = 0.001), weak but real. Neighbouring stations share things the model does not see, so the bootstrap intervals in this report, which treat stations as independent, are somewhat too narrow.

偏差指向数据未记录的原因。 高于预期的有：Bayfront（是估计值的 6.3 倍）、Kranji、HarbourFront、Downtown、Newton、Novena 与 Somerset。 低于预期的有：Keppel、Teck Lee、Petir、Marina Bay 与 Hume。其中几个可以想到某种解释，比如度假胜地、渡轮码头或陆路关卡，但这些只是猜测，只依赖零售数量和建筑占地的模型无法检验。其中一部分有空间组织：以六个最近车站为邻居，残差的 Moran’s I 为 0.18（p = 0.001）， 微弱但真实。相邻车站共享模型看不到的因素，所以本报告中假定车站相互独立的自助法区间略显偏窄。

8 Ridership at the proposed stations拟建车站的客流

8.1 Central estimates and their spread中心估计及其范围

A new station has no ridership to pivot on, so its estimate comes from the model directly: its markets, its attraction variables measured today, and its competition with every other station within 5 km. Around each central estimate, a 90% range comes from 300 draws. Each takes parameters from the bootstrap and gives the station an unexplained pull drawn from the hold-out errors on MRT stations, the model’s own record on stations it had not seen.

新站没有客流可供作为转折基准，所以估计直接来自模型：它的市场、当前测得的吸引力变量，以及它与 5 公里内所有其他车站的竞争。每个中心估计周围的 90% 范围来自 300 次抽样：每次从自助法中取参数， 并从地铁车站的留出误差中为车站抽取一个未解释的吸引力，也就是模型在未见车站上的实际记录。

Code 
nt <- NT |>
  mutate(station_name = fct_reorder(station_name, E_closed),
         stage = factor(stage, c("JRL Stage 1 (2028)", "JRL Stage 2 (2028)", "JRL Stage 3 (2029)", "CRL Phase 1 (2030)")))
ggplot(nt, aes(y = station_name)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = SC$HUME, linetype = 3, colour = PAL$grey) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = SC$LOW20, linetype = 2, colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo_closed, xend = hi_closed, yend = station_name), colour = PAL$new_l, linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(aes(x = E_closed), colour = PAL$new, size = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = E_open), shape = 4, size = 1.7, colour = PAL$ink) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma, breaks = c(1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 20000, 40000)) +
  facet_grid(stage ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Daily tap-ins (log scale)", y = NULL) +
  theme_th(10) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

Heartland stations lead, and the western industrial and airport stations trail. Serangoon North (19,900 a day, range 10,800 to 41,300) sits among dense estates and private housing with no station of its own. Choa Chu Kang West and Pasir Ris East are similar. The lowest are stations in places with few residents: Aviation Park, Jurong Pier, Tengah and Jurong Hill, around 3,000 a day. Ranges typically span a factor of about five, so any one station’s number is a rough guide. Their order is firmer. The new stations’ median, 7,792, is a little over half the MRT median today (13,844). That is expected: they are infill stations, tap-ins do not count the transfers these lines will carry, and today’s land use is the evidence.

组屋区车站居前，西部工业区与机场附近的车站居后。 Serangoon North（每日 19,900 次，范围 10,800 至 41,300）位于密集的组屋与私人住宅区，却没有自己的车站。 Choa Chu Kang West 与 Pasir Ris East 情况类似。最低的是居民稀少地点的车站：Aviation Park、Jurong Pier、Tengah 与 Jurong Hill，每日约 3,000 次。范围通常跨越约五倍，所以单站数字只是粗略参考，排序则更可靠。新站的中位数 7,792 略高于当前地铁车站中位数（13,844）的一半。 这在意料之中：它们是填补型车站，进站量不包括这些线路将承载的换乘客流，而证据也只是当前的土地利用。

Code 
nl <- NT |> mutate(home = E_H / E_closed)
map_base(
  net_layer(), new_layer(.8),
  geom_point(data = dE, aes(x, y), size = .4, colour = "#a8a29e"),
  geom_point(data = nl, aes(x, y, size = E_closed, fill = home), shape = 21, colour = "#44403c", stroke = .25),
  geom_text_repel(data = slice_max(nl, E_closed, n = 8), aes(x, y, label = station_name), size = 2.6, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = .2, seed = 6, box.padding = .4),
  geom_text_repel(data = slice_min(nl, E_closed, n = 5), aes(x, y, label = station_name), size = 2.6, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = .2, seed = 7, box.padding = .4, colour = PAL$grey)
) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_LINE, guide = "none") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 8, labels = comma, name = "Daily tap-ins", breaks = c(3000, 8000, 15000)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#b2182b", "#f7f7f7", "#2166ac"), limits = c(.1, .9), labels = percent, name = "Home share")

The two lines would do different jobs. Jurong Region Line stations together carry about 153,000 tap-ins a day, and those of Cross Island Line Phase 1 about 72,000, from 21 and 8 stations. The median station is about the same on both. Cross Island stations mostly serve homes (72% home share), while western stations such as Tukang, Jurong Pier and Jurong Hill are red: they would fill from workers leaving at the end of a shift, a demand whose reach this model pins down least well. Nanyang Crescent and Nanyang Gateway together carry about 17,000 a day in the closed model and 36,000 in the open one, either side of Kent Ridge’s 25,000, which serves the other large university campus.

两条线路承担不同的任务。 裕廊区域线各站合计每日约 153,000 次进站，跨岛线第一期约 72,000 次，分别来自 21 个和 8 个车站，中位车站大致相同。跨岛线车站主要服务住所（居住端比例 72%）， 而 Tukang、Jurong Pier、Jurong Hill 等西部车站呈红色：它们的客流来自下班离开的工人，这种需求的辐射范围是本模型最难确定的。Nanyang Crescent 与 Nanyang Gateway 合计每日在封闭模型中约 17,000 次，在开放模型中约 36,000 次，分居服务另一所大型大学校园的 Kent Ridge（25,000 次）两侧。

8.2 Which stations risk being the next ghost station哪些车站可能成为下一个幽灵站

A central estimate says little about risk, so each station is scored by how often its simulated ridership falls below two thresholds: Hume today (2,239 a day), and the boundary of the lowest fifth of MRT stations today (6,092). Hume is a fair yardstick, because it is the most recent station whose opening was postponed for lack of demand and it is in the same data.

中心估计很难说明风险，所以按模拟客流低于两个阈值的频率为每个车站打分：Hume 目前的客流（每日 2,239 次），以及当前地铁车站最低五分之一的界线（6,092 次）。Hume 是合适的标尺，因为它是最近一个因需求不足而推迟开放的车站，而且就在同一份数据中。

No station is more likely than not to fall below Hume: the highest is Aviation Park at 37%. But 12 of 29 have a better than even chance of being in the lowest fifth of MRT stations as they stand today. That is a warning about the opening year rather than about the decade. Stage 1 of the Jurong Region Line opens in 2028 and its Tengah stations are built ahead of the town, as Woodleigh was. Note also that the screen’s AUC of 0.87 is good at ranking, but the model’s tendency at the bottom is to overpredict: Hume itself is estimated at 6,424 and Keppel at 1,836, against 2,239 and 174 observed. A quiet station’s risk is likely to be understated, not overstated.

没有任何车站低于 Hume 的概率超过一半：最高的是 Aviation Park，为 37%。但 29 个车站中有 12 个落入当前地铁车站最低五分之一的概率超过一半。这是对开通初期的警示，而不是对未来十年的判断。 裕廊区域线第一阶段 2028 年开通，登加的车站先于市镇建成，就像当年的 Woodleigh。还要注意，这一筛查的 AUC 为 0.87，排序能力较好，但模型在底部倾向于高估：Hume 本身被估计为 6,424 次，Keppel 为 1,836 次，而观测值分别为 2,239 次与 174 次。所以冷清车站的风险更可能被低估，而不是高估。

8.3 If the land use changes如果土地利用发生变化

Buangkok shows what a model of today’s land use cannot see. A forecast made when it was shut would have looked much like Tengah’s does now. As a partial test, 30,230 residents of flats completed in 2026 are added, along with Tengah at its planned size. The town is planned for about 42,000 homes, some 30,000 of them HDB flats (Wikipedia contributors, 2026d), against 16,318 HDB flats in the data now, so 41,046 more residents are spread evenly over its 34 hexagons at 3 persons a flat, and private housing is left out. Tengah’s own stations rise (Tbl. 8), Tengah Plantation by 41% and Tengah by 63%. The Tengah station’s estimate remains low, partly because the town’s other stations share the same market. Shops, jobs and bus services would arrive with those homes and raise attractiveness as well, which this test leaves unchanged, so it understates the eventual effect.

Buangkok 说明了基于当前土地利用的模型看不到什么：它关闭时所做的预测，大概和今天的 Tengah 差不多。作为部分检验，加入 2026 年竣工单位的 30,230 名居民，以及规划规模下的登加。该市镇规划约 42,000 套住宅，其中约 30,000 套为 HDB 组屋 (Wikipedia contributors, 2026d)，而数据中目前有 16,318 套， 所以按每套 3 人把另外 41,046 名居民平均分配到其 34 个六边形上，私人住宅未计入。登加本身的车站有所上升（Tbl. 8）：Tengah Plantation 上升 41%，Tengah 上升 63%。 Tengah 站的估计仍然偏低，部分原因是该市镇的其他车站共享同一市场。商店、就业与公交服务将随这些住宅一起到来，也会提高吸引力，而这一检验没有改变吸引力，所以低估了最终效果。

9 Impact on existing stations对既有车站的影响

9.1 Who loses, and how far it reaches谁受损，影响能到多远

For an existing station the model is used only for a ratio, the station’s expected ridership on the proposed network over its expected ridership on today’s, separately for each end of the trip. That ratio is applied to what the station actually carries. A station the model underestimates keeps its real level. Under the closed model existing stations lose 197,555 tap-ins a day, 6.7% of today’s total, against the 224,865 the new stations carry. The two would be nearly equal in the model’s own units; they differ here because each station’s loss is proportional to what it really carries rather than to what the model assigned it.

对既有车站，模型只用于一个比值：车站在拟建网络上的预期客流与在当前网络上的预期客流之比，按出行两端分别计算，再把这个比值乘到车站的实际客流上。模型低估的车站仍保持其真实水平。在封闭模型下，既有车站每日损失 197,555 次进站，占当前总量的 6.7%，而新站承载 224,865 次。两者在模型自身的单位中应当几乎相等；这里有差异，是因为每个车站的损失与其实际客流成比例，而不是与模型分配给它的客流成比例。

Code 
ot <- OT |> mutate(ch_cl = pmax(pmin(chg_closed, .5), -.6))
lab <- OT |> slice_min(chg_closed, n = 10)
lab2 <- OT |> filter(role == "existing, gains a line", chg_closed > .1)
map_base(
  net_layer(), new_layer(.5),
  geom_point(data = NT, aes(x, y), size = 1.1, colour = PAL$new),
  geom_point(data = ot, aes(x, y, fill = ch_cl, size = abs(abs_closed)), shape = 21, colour = "#78716c", stroke = .15),
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(x, y, label = paste0(station_name, " ", chg(chg_closed))), size = 2.5, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = .2, seed = 8, box.padding = .45, max.overlaps = 30),
  geom_text_repel(data = lab2, aes(x, y, label = paste0(station_name, " ", chg(chg_closed))), size = 2.5, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = .2, seed = 9, box.padding = .45, colour = "#1d4ed8")
) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_LINE, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = RAMP_DIV, limits = c(-.6, .6), labels = percent, name = "Change") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 6, labels = comma, name = "Tap-ins gained\nor lost a day", breaks = c(2000, 8000, 20000))

The cost falls on the western stations the Jurong Region Line runs beside. Pioneer, Lakeside, Chinese Garden and Joo Koon lose more than half their tap-ins, and Boon Lay and Bukit Batok more than a third, because the residents of Jurong West and Bukit Batok West who walk or bus to them today, and at Joo Koon the workers of the industrial estates, would gain a nearer station. The largest absolute loss is at Pioneer, about 21,000 a day. Along the Cross Island Line the effect is milder, about a fifth at Kovan, Mayflower and Tampines East. Read these as upper bounds. They come from the closed model, which credits every new rider to an existing station, and the open model reduces most of them by a few points. Changi Airport’s −25% should not be taken at face value: its tap-ins are air passengers and airport staff, not nearby residents, so applying a ratio from the local market overstates its loss.

代价落在裕廊区域线沿线的西部车站。 Pioneer、Lakeside、Chinese Garden 与 Joo Koon 损失一半以上的进站量，Boon Lay 与 Bukit Batok 损失三分之一以上，因为今天步行或乘公交前往这些车站的裕廊西与武吉巴督西居民，以及 Joo Koon 工业区的工人，将有一个更近的车站。绝对损失最大的是 Pioneer，每日约 21,000 次。跨岛线沿线的影响较温和，Kovan、Mayflower 与 Tampines East 约为五分之一。这些数字应视为上限：它们来自封闭模型，该模型把每位新乘客都算作来自既有车站，开放模型会使其中多数减少几个百分点。Changi Airport 的 −25% 不应照字面理解：其进站者是航空旅客与机场员工，而不是附近居民，所以套用本地市场的比值高估了它的损失。

Code 
mids <- c(.5, 1.5, 2.5, 4, 6.5, 10)
bd <- SC$by_distance |> mutate(km = mids[seq_len(n())])
ggplot(OT, aes(km_new, chg_closed)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = role == "existing, gains a line", size = daily_in), alpha = .65) +
  geom_line(data = bd, aes(km, median_chg), colour = PAL$ink, linewidth = .7) +
  geom_point(data = bd, aes(km, median_chg), colour = PAL$ink, size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1d4ed8", `FALSE` = PAL$new), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 4.5, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Distance to nearest new access point (km)", y = "Change in daily tap-ins") +
  theme_th(10)

The effect is local, and fades to nothing where it should. Within 2 km of a new station the median existing station loses about a fifth of its tap-ins (−22% under 1 km, −21% from 1 to 2 km). By 3 to 5 km it has fallen to −6%, by 5 to 8 km −0.6%, and beyond 8 km it is effectively zero. Of the 184 existing stations, 81 lose more than 5%, and 87 are more than 5 km from anything new. An earlier version of this model, with no limit on access, gave stations 8 to 12 km away a median loss of about 10% (§6.2), which shows why this picture had to be checked as well as the fit. The spread within a band is large, because a station’s loss depends on how much of its market lies toward the new station and on how many alternatives are nearby.

影响是局部的，并在该消失的地方消失。 在新站 2 公里内，既有车站的进站量中位数损失约五分之一（1 公里内 −22%，1 至 2 公里 −21%）。到 3 至 5 公里降至 −6%，5 至 8 公里 −0.6%，8 公里以外实际上为零。在 184 个既有车站中， 81 个损失超过 5%，87 个距任何新站超过 5 公里。此前不限制到达距离的模型版本曾让 8 至 12 公里外的车站损失中位数约 10%（§6.2），这说明除了拟合度，这样的图也必须检查。同一距离带内差异很大，因为车站的损失取决于其市场有多少位于新站方向，以及附近还有多少替代选择。

9.2 Stations that gain a line增加线路的车站

For the seven stations gaining a line, the answer depends on an assumption the data can barely test. The model estimates that each extra line multiplies a station’s pull by about 1.7, but that comes from comparing stations, and interchanges tend to be in town centres. Whether adding a line to an existing station has the same effect is not something three months of data can show. Tbl. 10 therefore gives both ends.

对增加线路的七个车站，答案取决于一个数据几乎无法检验的假设。模型估计每多一条线路，车站吸引力约变为 1.7 倍，但这来自车站之间的比较，而换乘站往往位于市镇中心。给现有车站增加一条线路是否有同样效果，三个月的数据无法说明。因此 Tbl. 10 给出了两端的结果。

The sign changes at five of them. Ang Mo Kio moves from −16% to +19%, Hougang from −12% to +26%. Only Boon Lay and Jurong East fall on both, because the Jurong Region Line’s stations take so much of their catchments. The honest conclusion is that tap-ins at these seven stations are not reliably predicted in either direction, and that the more certain change there is in transfers, which § 10.2 takes up.

其中五个车站的符号会改变。Ang Mo Kio 从 −16% 变为 +19%，Hougang 从 −12% 变为 +26%。只有 Boon Lay 与 Jurong East 在两种情形下都下降，因为裕廊区域线的车站取走了它们太多的集散范围。实事求是的结论是：这七个车站的进站量无论朝哪个方向都无法可靠预测，更确定的变化在于换乘，§ 10.2 将讨论这一点。

9.3 Market areas市场区

Code 
hi <- hex |> select(hex_id) |> inner_join(SC$hex_impact, by = c("hex_id" = "origin")) |> filter(residents > 0)
map_base(
  geom_sf(data = hi, aes(fill = share_new), colour = NA),
  geom_sf(data = filter(hi, to_new), fill = NA, colour = "#44403c", linewidth = .22),
  net_layer("#78716c", .22), new_layer(.5),
  geom_point(data = NT, aes(x, y), size = .9, colour = "white"),
  geom_point(data = NT, aes(x, y), size = .5, colour = PAL$ink)
) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_LINE, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#fff7ec", "#fdd49e", "#fc8d59", "#d7301f", "#7f0000"), limits = c(0, 1), labels = percent,
                       name = "Share to\nnew stations")

About one resident in fourteen would have a new first choice, and many more would have a new option. The dominant station changes for hexagons holding 400,391 residents, and for 310,167 of them (7.3% of all residents) it becomes a new station. These are the outlined hexagons. The shaded area is wider: 16% of residents live where more than a fifth of the market goes to new stations. The map also shows the limit of a boundary. Hexagons outside the outline, holding 172,000 residents, still send more than a third of their market to a new station, which a nearest-station map would call no change at all. The Huff model’s probabilities are what register it.

约每十四位居民中就有一位的首选车站将变为新站，而有新选择的居民要多得多。 主导车站发生变化的六边形共有 400,391 名居民，其中 310,167 名（占全部居民的 7.3%）的主导车站变为新站，即图中带轮廓线的六边形。阴影范围更广：16% 的居民所在之处，有超过五分之一的市场流向新站。 这张图也显示了边界的局限。轮廓线之外的六边形中有 172,000 名居民，那里仍有超过三分之一的市场流向新站，而最近车站地图会说这里毫无变化。记录这种变化的正是 Huff 模型的概率。

Code 
west <- c(xmin = 8500, xmax = 24000, ymin = 30500, ymax = 44000)
dom_map <- function(col, title, show_new) {
  d <- hi |> filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) |> group_by(st = .data[[col]]) |> summarise(.groups = "drop")
  d$k <- factor(((seq_len(nrow(d)) * 7) %% 11) + 1)
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = land, fill = "#f5f5f4", colour = "#d6d3d1", linewidth = .25) +
    geom_sf(data = d, aes(fill = k), colour = "white", linewidth = .4, alpha = .8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = dE, aes(x, y), size = .9, colour = PAL$ink) +
    { if (show_new) geom_point(data = NT, aes(x, y), size = 1.4, colour = PAL$new) } +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
    coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = FALSE, xlim = west[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = west[c("ymin", "ymax")]) +
    labs(title = title) + theme_map(10)
}
dom_map("dominant_old", "Today", FALSE) + dom_map("dominant_new", "With the Jurong Region Line", TRUE)

The western market areas contract. Today Boon Lay, Lakeside and Pioneer dominate large areas of Jurong West that are well beyond walking distance. With the Jurong Region Line those areas divide among Gek Poh, Corporation, Jurong West and Bahar Junction, and Boon Lay’s dominant area alone loses 38,398 residents. Lakeside loses 29,995, and Bukit Gombak 30,565. The probability-weighted average distance a station’s riders travel to reach it falls by 7% at the median station within 2 km of a new one: riders who remain live nearer. This is the behaviour hoped for in a transit-oriented plan, shorter access for the same trip. The price is lower ridership at what are today some of the west’s busier stations.

西部市场区收缩。 今天 Boon Lay、Lakeside 与 Pioneer 主导着裕廊西大片超出步行距离的区域。裕廊区域线开通后，这些区域被 Gek Poh、Corporation、Jurong West 与 Bahar Junction 瓜分：仅 Boon Lay 的主导区就减少 38,398 名居民，Lakeside 减少 29,995 名，Bukit Gombak 减少 30,565 名。 在新站 2 公里内的车站，乘客到达车站的概率加权平均距离中位数下降 7%：留下来的乘客住得更近。这正是公共交通导向规划所期望的：同样的出行，更短的到达距离。代价则是今天西部一些较繁忙车站的客流下降。

9.4 How much the answer depends on the choices答案在多大程度上取决于这些选择

The ranking of new stations is firm, and the far-field test separates the specifications. In every case but one, the order of new stations correlates with the main case at about 0.88 or better. Totals move more, from about 177,000 to 279,000 a day. The largest single assumption is how the Jurong Region Line’s medium capacity counts: at half the LRT effect the line drops from 153,000 to 105,000. The 250 m and 1,000 m grids barely change the result (Openshaw, 1984), and neither do a larger distance floor or the committed Bedok South, Sungei Bedok and Xilin stations.

The last column but one is the most telling. Three cases give existing stations far from anything new a loss of over 10%: no maximum distance, a single model of all tap-ins, and exact calibration as in huff.fit(). All three have no distance limit, and that is the cause; exact calibration barely adds to it (−10.4% against −10.2%). Its own fault is different. Reading unexplained ridership as attractiveness, it stretches Kranji’s mean catchment from 1.7 to 5.2 km. Existing stations are therefore pivoted rather than calibrated.

新站排序很稳健，远场检验则能区分不同设定。 除一种情形外，新站排序与主情形的相关都在 0.88 以上。总量变化更大，从每日约 177,000 到 279,000 次。最大的单一假设是如何看待裕廊区域线的中运量：按轻轨效应的一半计算，该线从 153,000 降至 105,000。250 米与 1,000 米网格几乎不改变结果 (Openshaw, 1984)，较大的距离下限以及已确定的 Bedok South、Sungei Bedok 与 Xilin 车站也是如此。

倒数第二列最能说明问题。有三种情形让远离新站的既有车站损失超过 10%：不设最大距离、单一全量进站模型，以及 huff.fit() 那样的精确校准。这三种都不限制距离，这才是原因；精确校准几乎没有加剧这一点（−10.4% 对 −10.2%）。它自身的问题不同：把未解释的客流读作吸引力，使 Kranji 的平均集散范围从 1.7 公里拉长到 5.2 公里。因此既有车站采用转折基准，而不是精确校准。

10 Value-added analysis附加价值分析

The core model answers where a trip enters the network, on the assumption that the number of trips is fixed. Two extensions address what that leaves out. Neither adds new data; both change what the model can say.

核心模型回答的是出行从哪里进入网络，并假定出行总量固定。两项扩展针对其遗漏之处。它们都没有增加新数据，改变的是模型能够说明的内容。

10.1 How much ridership is new? An outside option有多少客流是新增的？外部选项

The question. In a closed Huff model all of a hexagon’s market goes to some station, so a new station can only take riders from others. Yet a large part of the case for new lines is that some people who do not use rail today would. This is decisive for the question in RQ3: the more of the new stations’ riders are new to rail, the less existing stations lose.

The method. An outside option adds the choice of not using the rail network at the home end, with a constant attractiveness \(A_0\) in the denominator of the Huff probability. A resident close to good stations mostly chooses rail. One far from any station often does not. With \(A_0\) calibrated alongside the other parameters, the model’s total ridership can rise when a new station arrives. The activity end is left closed, so a new home-end rider’s return trip is not counted, which makes the induced share a modest understatement. The assumption is that the choice of rail, within a hexagon, depends on the same attractiveness and decay as the choice between stations, without separate mode costs.

问题。 在封闭的 Huff 模型中，一个六边形的全部市场都流向某个车站，所以新站只能从其他车站抢乘客。但新线的一大理由是今天不用轨道的人将来可能会用。这对研究问题三至关重要：新站乘客中轨道新用户越多，既有车站的损失就越小。

方法。 外部选项在居住端加入不使用铁路网的选择，也就是在 Huff 概率的分母中加入一个常数吸引力 \(A_0\)。靠近优质车站的居民大多选择轨道，远离任何车站的居民则常常不选。\(A_0\) 与其他参数一起校准后，新站到来时模型的总客流可以上升。活动端保持封闭，所以新增居住端乘客的返程没有计入，这使新增比例略被低估。假设是：在一个六边形内，是否选择轨道取决于与车站之间选择相同的吸引力和衰减，没有单独的方式成本。

Code 
pa <- RP$prof_a0 |> filter(lA0 <= 2) |> mutate(induced = share_induced)
p1 <- pa |>
  pivot_longer(c(share_outside, induced)) |>
  mutate(name = recode(name, share_outside = "Market that stays off rail", induced = "New stations' home riders who are new")) |>
  ggplot(aes(A0, value, colour = name)) + geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#57534e", PAL$new), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = expression(A[0] ~ "(log scale)"), y = NULL) + theme_th(9.5) + guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
p2 <- pa |>
  pivot_longer(c(insample, lolo)) |>
  mutate(name = recode(name, insample = "In sample", lolo = "Line held out")) |>
  ggplot(aes(A0, value, colour = name)) + geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(.45, .75)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#a8a29e", PAL$new), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = expression(A[0] ~ "(log scale)"), y = "Home-end R²") + theme_th(9.5) + guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
p1 + p2

The insight: these data cannot say how much new ridership the lines would create. The fitted \(A_0\) is 1.94, which says about 36% of the new stations’ riders are new to rail, and its 95% interval runs from effectively zero to 11. Across that range in-sample fit stays at 0.69, while the implied share of new riders at the home end goes from about 6% to about 89%. Hold-out fit does fall (0.64 to 0.54), which leans toward fewer new riders without settling it. The reason is geographic: 99% of residents already live within 2 km of a station, so almost no one in the data is far enough away to reveal what distance does to the choice to use rail at all. Before-and-after ridership around a line opening could.

So the two models are best read as bounds: existing stations lose 197,555 a day in the closed model and 155,900 in the open one. New-station totals are 224,865 and 255,299. About two-thirds of that difference comes from Nanyang Crescent and Nanyang Gateway, where the open model gives the dormitory market more weight, a sign of how weakly that weight is determined.

洞见：这些数据无法说明新线将创造多少新增客流。 拟合的 \(A_0\) 为 1.94，表示新站乘客中约 36% 是轨道新用户，其 95% 区间从几乎为零到 11。在这个范围内，样本内拟合始终约为 0.69，而居住端隐含的新增乘客比例却从约 6% 变到约 89%。留出拟合确实下降（0.64 至 0.54），这偏向新增乘客较少的情形，但不足以定论。原因在于地理： 99% 的居民已住在车站 2 公里以内，数据中几乎没有住得足够远的人，能够揭示距离如何影响是否使用轨道。线路开通前后的客流才能做到。

因此两个模型最好看作上下界：既有车站每日损失在封闭模型中为 197,555 次，在开放模型中为 155,900 次。新站总量分别为 224,865 次与 255,299 次。其中约三分之二的差异来自 Nanyang Crescent 与 Nanyang Gateway，开放模型给宿舍市场更大的权重，这本身也说明该权重的确定有多么薄弱。

10.2 Where do the riders go? MCI on origin-destination shares乘客去向何处？基于起讫份额的 MCI

The question. Huff’s model ends at the gate. A new station’s rider is still going somewhere, and that changes which lines fill and where people change. A station-level result can even mislead here: tap-ins at Boon Lay would fall, but what is happening on its platforms?

The method. A multiplicative competitive interaction model (Nakanishi & Cooper, 1974) is fitted to the observed shares: given a trip starts at station \(i\), the share going to station \(j\) depends on rail time and on the destination’s attributes. Log-centring within each origin turns it into linear regression. mci.fit() in MCI (Wieland, 2017) needs a complete table and stops on this one, because 1,466 of the 33,672 station pairs recorded no trips, so the transformation is done directly, and it reproduces mci.fit() to within 4e-16 on a complete 25 by 25 block of the table.

Three adjustments follow, each found by testing the model against what is known. Ordinary least squares gives a pair with 0.02 trips a day the same weight as one with 5,000, and the many rarely used pairs pull trips too short: 12.8 minutes on average against 18.7 observed, and weighting by trips helps little (14.0). So the distance exponent alone is recalibrated to the observed mean trip length (Hyman, 1969), and separately for three rings around the CBD, because one exponent overstates trips from the periphery, exactly where the new stations are (Tbl. 12). Then a new destination should not attract trips from everywhere, because someone now living near Gek Poh simply stops arriving at Boon Lay. Stations balance over a day (tap-ins and tap-outs correlate at 0.993), so arrivals are made to move with boardings, and the flow matrix is balanced to both (Furness, 1965). Existing pairs pivot from observed flows; only pairs involving a new station come from the model alone. Every flow then takes the fastest path through a rail graph.

问题。 Huff 模型止于闸机。新站的乘客总要去某个地方，这决定了哪些线路变满、人们在哪里换乘。车站层面的结果在这里甚至可能误导：Boon Lay 的进站量会下降，但它的站台上发生了什么？

方法。 对观测份额拟合乘法竞争交互模型 (Nakanishi & Cooper, 1974)：给定一次出行从车站 \(i\) 出发，前往车站 \(j\) 的份额取决于轨道时间与目的地属性。在每个起点内做对数中心化后，它就变成线性回归。MCI (Wieland, 2017) 的 mci.fit() 需要完整的表，而这里有 33,672 个站对中的 1,466 个没有出行记录，所以直接进行变换；在表中一个完整的 25×25 区块上，它与 mci.fit() 的差距在 4e-16 以内。

随后进行三项调整，每一项都来自对已知事实的检验。普通最小二乘给每日 0.02 次的站对与每日 5,000 次的站对相同权重，大量极少使用的站对把出行拉得太短：平均 12.8 分钟，而观测为 18.7 分钟，按出行量加权也帮助不大（14.0）。所以只把距离指数重新校准到观测的平均出行时长 (Hyman, 1969)，并对 CBD 周围三个环分别校准，因为单一指数高估了外围的出行时长，而新站恰恰都在外围（Tbl. 12）。此外，新目的地不应从各处吸引出行：现在住在 Gek Poh 附近的人只是不再到达 Boon Lay。车站一天内是平衡的（进站与出站的相关系数为 0.993），所以让到达量随上车量变动，并使流量矩阵同时满足两者 (Furness, 1965)。既有站对以观测流量为基准，只有涉及新站的站对完全来自模型。然后每个流量都走铁路网图上最快的路径。

Fit. Rail time and attraction together give a log-centred R² of 0.47, against 0.33 with straight-line distance, so the rail graph earns its place. At the level that matters, the model reproduces station arrivals with an R² of 0.64, and 0.44 for arrivals at stations held out with their line. It is much weaker on individual pairs (R² of 0.40 on pairs with at least 10 trips a day), which is why existing pairs pivot from what was observed.

拟合。 轨道时间与吸引力一起给出的对数中心化 R² 为 0.47，而用直线距离只有 0.33，所以铁路网图确有价值。在重要的层面上，模型对车站到达量的 R² 为 0.64，对随线路留出的车站到达量为 0.44。它在单个站对上要弱得多（每日至少 10 次的站对 R² 为 0.40），这就是既有站对以观测值为基准的原因。

Code 
xf <- MC$xfer |> slice_max(change, n = 8) |>
  mutate(station_name = fct_reorder(station_name, change))
p1 <- ggplot(xf, aes(y = station_name)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = base, xend = after, yend = station_name), colour = PAL$new_l, linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = base), colour = "#a8a29e", size = 2.2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = after), colour = PAL$new, size = 2.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Daily transfers: today (grey), proposed (orange)", y = NULL) + theme_th(9.5)
lk <- MC$links |> filter(base > 0) |> mutate(pc = pmax(pmin(pct, .3), -.3))
p2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "#f5f5f4", colour = "#d6d3d1", linewidth = .25) +
  geom_segment(data = filter(MC$links, base == 0), aes(x = ax, y = ay, xend = bx, yend = by), colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = .6) +
  geom_segment(data = lk, aes(x = ax, y = ay, xend = bx, yend = by, colour = pc, linewidth = base)) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = RAMP_DIV, limits = c(-.3, .3), labels = percent, name = "Load change") +
  scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(.3, 2.2), labels = comma, name = "Load today") +
  coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = FALSE, xlim = XL, ylim = YL) +
  theme_map(9.5)
p1 + p2 + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))

The insight: stations that lose tap-ins gain something else. 46% of Jurong Region Line boardings and 64% of Cross Island Line boardings leave the new line for somewhere beyond it, so these are largely feeder lines. Boon Lay would see 63,000 transfers a day where it has none now, while its tap-ins change by −37%. Hougang, Ang Mo Kio and Choa Chu Kang each add about 41,000. Doubling the transfer penalty leaves Boon Lay’s gain at 56,000.

On the links, the Jurong Region Line relieves the western ends of the two oldest lines (Jurong East to Chinese Garden −31%, Jurong East to Bukit Batok −31%), but the relief stops at Jurong East: Clementi to Jurong East changes by only −2%. The Cross Island Line eases the Circle Line (Serangoon to Lorong Chuan −13%) and adds load below Pasir Ris (+12%). Passenger-kilometres stay level, at 14.15 million a day against 14.17 million. The loads compare two networks under simple assignment, with no crowding or route choice, and do not forecast any link’s crowding.

洞见：损失进站量的车站会得到别的东西。 裕廊区域线上车乘客的 46%、跨岛线上车乘客的 64% 会离开新线前往更远的地方，所以它们在很大程度上是接驳线路。Boon Lay 今天没有换乘，届时每日将有 63,000 次，而其进站量变化 −37%。Hougang、Ang Mo Kio 与 Choa Chu Kang 各增加约 41,000 次。换乘惩罚加倍后，Boon Lay 的增量仍有 56,000 次。

在区段上，裕廊区域线缓解了两条最老线路的西端（Jurong East 至 Chinese Garden −31%，Jurong East 至 Bukit Batok −31%），但缓解止于 Jurong East：Clementi 至 Jurong East 只变化 −2%。跨岛线减轻了环线的负荷（Serangoon 至 Lorong Chuan −13%），并增加 Pasir Ris 以南的负荷（+12%）。乘客公里基本持平，每日 14.15 百万对 14.17 百万。这些负荷比较的是简单分配下的两个网络，不含拥挤与路径选择，并不预测任何区段的拥挤程度。

11 Integrated findings and discussion综合结论与讨论

11.1 Answers to the research questions对研究问题的回答

RQ1: calibration. A Huff model built on distance alone explains nothing about Singapore’s stations. Mode, interchange status, retail and connection to the city do the explaining, and a model with these reaches a held-out R² of 0.67 and a rank correlation of 0.86 on lines it never saw. It beats a direct regression on the same variables because stations compete. Home-end access decays at about −2.1, which supports the convention; the activity-end exponent is much less certain. Bus stop counts, recommended in the brief, add nothing once retail is in the model.

RQ2: prediction. The 29 new access points would carry about 225,000 tap-ins a day on today’s land use. This central estimate rests on typical stations; simulated totals run from 216,000 to 306,000, higher because errors with a long upper tail add up that way. Stations range from about 2,600 to 20,000 a day. Heartland infill does best. The risk of low ridership concentrates in Aviation Park, Jurong Pier, Tengah, Jurong Hill and Peng Kang Hill, and for most of these, what is built around them by opening day will matter more than anything in this model.

RQ3: impact. Existing stations lose 155,900 to 197,555 tap-ins a day, depending on how much ridership is new. The loss is local: a median of about a fifth within 2 km of a new station, and nothing beyond 8 km. The western stations along the East-West Line are hit hardest. Dominant market areas change for 400,391 residents, and existing stations keep riders who live closer to them.

Beyond the gate. These are largely feeder lines. A majority of Cross Island Line boardings and a large minority of Jurong Region Line boardings leave for elsewhere, so the stations that lose tap-ins become the interchanges that carry them onward.

研究问题一：校准。 只依靠距离的 Huff 模型对新加坡的车站毫无解释力。真正起解释作用的是制式、换乘地位、零售以及与市区的连接；包含这些变量的模型，在从未见过的线路上达到 0.67 的留出 R² 和 0.86 的秩相关。它优于基于相同变量的直接回归，因为车站之间存在竞争。居住端的到达过程以约 −2.1 的指数衰减，支持了这一惯例；活动端的指数则不确定得多。题目推荐的公交站数量，在纳入零售后不再增加任何解释力。

研究问题二：预测。 按当前土地利用，29 个新进站点每日约有 225,000 次进站。这个中心估计基于典型车站；模拟总量从 216,000 到 306,000 次，更高是因为长上尾的误差相加就是如此。单站每日约 2,600 至 20,000 次。组屋区填补型车站表现最好。低客流风险集中在 Aviation Park、Jurong Pier、Tengah、Jurong Hill 与 Peng Kang Hill，对其中多数车站而言，开通时周边建成了什么，比模型中的任何因素都重要。

研究问题三：影响。 既有车站每日损失 155,900 至 197,555 次进站，取决于有多少客流是新增的。损失是局部的：新站 2 公里内中位数约五分之一，8 公里外为零。东西线西段的车站受影响最大。主导市场区变化涉及 400,391 名居民，既有车站留住的是住得更近的乘客。

闸机之外。 这些线路在很大程度上是接驳线。跨岛线的多数上车乘客和裕廊区域线相当一部分上车乘客都会前往别处，所以损失进站量的车站会成为把他们送往下一程的换乘站。

11.2 What the methods learned from each other不同方法之间的相互启发

Three of this report’s decisions came from results that looked fine on the usual measures and failed on a plausibility check. Exact calibration fits every station by construction, and it tripled Kranji’s mean catchment. A model with no maximum distance had the best hold-out score, and it took 10% of ridership from stations 10 km from anything new. A single exponent matched the network’s mean trip length, and it overstated the very trips that matter here by almost a fifth. In each case the fit statistic alone would have recommended the wrong model. A forecast needs checking against what the forecast is for, which here means asking how far a station’s effect should reach and how long a peripheral trip really is.

本报告有三项决策来自这样的结果：它们在常规指标上看起来很好，却没有通过合理性检验。精确校准按构造能拟合每个车站，却让 Kranji 的平均集散范围扩大到三倍。不设最大距离的模型留出分数最高，却让距任何新站 10 公里的车站损失 10% 的客流。单一指数符合全网的平均出行时长，却把这里最关键的那些出行高估了近五分之一。 在每种情况下，只看拟合统计量都会选错模型。预测必须针对其目的加以检验，这里就是要问：一个车站的影响应当延伸多远，外围的一次出行实际上有多长。

11.3 Geovisualisation and geocommunication choices地理可视化与地理传播的选择

The figures follow a few rules, chosen so that a reader who skips the text can still read the maps correctly.

  • One colour, one meaning. On maps of existing stations, orange marks a new one. On every diverging scale, red is loss or below expectation and blue is gain or above it, and on the home share map red marks a station people arrive at. Existing lines are grey so that the new lines stand out in their official colours.
  • Size for volume, colour for rate. Losing half of 3,000 tap-ins and losing half of 35,000 are very different, so the impact map shows both. Ridership spans a factor of 400, so tap-in charts use a log scale and say so.
  • Show the range. Each new station’s estimate appears with its 90% range, since a single number would claim far more than the model can support.
  • Probabilities as well as boundaries. A dominant station map hides most of what the Huff model says. Fig. 14 shows the share itself, with the boundary as an outline on top.
  • Reference points a reader knows. Hume and the lowest fifth of MRT stations stand on the prediction chart, because “3,000 a day” means little without something to compare it with.
  • Captions and commentary state the reading. Each commentary block leads with its conclusion in bold, then gives the evidence, in under 200 words.

这些图遵循几条规则，目的是让跳过文字的读者也能正确读图。

  • 一种颜色，一种含义。 在既有车站的地图上，橙色表示新站。在所有发散色标上，红色表示损失或低于预期，蓝色表示增加或高于预期；在居住端比例图上，红色表示人们前往的车站。既有线路为灰色，使新线以官方颜色突出显示。
  • 大小表示数量，颜色表示比率。 损失 3,000 次进站量的一半与损失 35,000 次的一半大不相同，所以影响图同时显示两者。客流跨越 400 倍，所以进站量图使用对数尺度并加以说明。
  • 显示范围。 每个新站的估计都附有 90% 范围，因为单一数字声称的确定性远超模型所能支持。
  • 既有概率也有边界。 主导车站图隐藏了 Huff 模型的大部分内容。Fig. 14 显示份额本身，并以轮廓线叠加边界。
  • 读者熟悉的参照点。 预测图上标出 Hume 和地铁车站最低五分之一的界线，因为“每日 3,000 次”若没有比较对象，意义不大。
  • 题注与评论说明读法。 每段评论都以粗体结论开头，再给出证据，篇幅不超过 200 词。

12 Implications for transport planning对交通规划的启示

The handout’s list of report sections carries over wording from the previous exercise (“peace-keeping”, “public safety”). This section reads those as implications for the policy question this exercise poses, which is sustainable rail planning. These are one student’s readings of a model with the limits set out in § 13, offered as questions the analysis raises rather than as recommendations to a transport authority.
