Sequence shell stations by land use, not by line. The stations at risk of low ridership are identifiable well ahead of time: Aviation Park, Jurong Pier, Tengah, Jurong Hill. The Hume and Woodleigh precedent suggests a choice that an operator can revisit: build the structure with the line, and tie fit-out and opening to a measurable threshold in the surrounding market. Keppel, open and nearly empty, shows the running cost of doing the opposite.

Plan interchanges for transfers, not for the tap-ins this report predicts. Boon Lay, Hougang, Ang Mo Kio and Choa Chu Kang each stand to gain tens of thousands of daily transfers. Station-level ridership would not reveal this, and a forecast of falling tap-ins at Boon Lay could read as reassurance. Boon Lay in particular has no transfer flow today.

Expect western East-West stations to change character. Pioneer, Lakeside and Chinese Garden lose much of their home-end catchment, as do feeder bus routes that serve them today. Bus network planning is the natural counterpart. The riders who leave these stations are those who lived furthest from them, so the same residents with shorter access is a gain, even though the station’s tap-ins fall.

Measure the opening. The largest unknown in this report, how much ridership a new line creates, could be settled by data the system already produces. Stage-by-stage openings of the Jurong Region Line from 2028 are a natural experiment. Saving OD data around each one, which DataMall deletes after three months, would allow a before-and-after estimate that no cross-section can give.

手册所列的报告章节沿用了上一次作业的措辞（“维和”“公共安全”）。本节把它们理解为本次作业所提政策问题的启示，即可持续的轨道规划。这些只是一名学生基于具有 § 13 所述局限的模型所作的解读，是分析提出的问题，而非对交通主管部门的建议。

按土地利用而非线路安排外壳车站的时序。 低客流风险的车站可以提前识别：Aviation Park、Jurong Pier、Tengah、Jurong Hill。Hume 与 Woodleigh 的先例提示了一个可以调整的选择：随线路建好结构，并把装修与开放与周边市场的可测阈值挂钩。Keppel 已开放却几乎无人使用，显示了相反做法的运营代价。

按换乘而不是本报告预测的进站量来规划换乘站。 Boon Lay、Hougang、Ang Mo Kio 与 Choa Chu Kang 每日都将增加数万次换乘。车站层面的客流不会显示这一点，而 Boon Lay 进站量下降的预测甚至可能被解读为令人安心。Boon Lay 今天尤其没有换乘客流。

预期东西线西段车站的性质改变。 Pioneer、Lakeside 与 Chinese Garden 将失去大部分居住端集散范围，服务它们的接驳公交也是如此。公交网络规划是自然的配套。离开这些车站的乘客是住得最远的那些人，所以同样的居民到达距离变短是一种收益，尽管车站的进站量下降。

对开通进行测量。 本报告最大的未知数，也就是新线能创造多少客流，可以用系统已经产生的数据来回答。裕廊区域线自 2028 年起的分阶段开通是天然实验。保存每次开通前后的 OD 数据（DataMall 三个月后即删除），就能得到任何截面数据都无法提供的前后对比估计。

13 Limitations局限

A cross-section, not a change. Everything rests on two months of one network. The model says that a station with more retail has more riders, not that adding retail adds riders, and a new line’s effect on existing stations is inferred from how stations compete today. It has not been observed. DataMall keeps only the three latest months, so no earlier opening could be used to test the prediction.

Land use is today’s. Attraction variables at proposed stations describe what stands there now. Tengah and the Jurong Innovation District will change, and the shops and bus services that follow new homes are not modelled. As Buangkok shows, ridership can eventually bear little relation to what surrounded a station on opening day.

Demand is measured indirectly. Residents date from June 2024, with later HDB blocks estimated. The counts cover citizens and permanent residents, so other non-residents are left out, and the dormitory column reaches only those who live in buildings OSM tags as dormitories. Workplace footprint has no heights, so the CBD is understated, and OSM’s mapping varies from place to place. The morning split of ridership is a proxy, and the activity end’s weak decay estimate reflects it.

Distance is a straight line. Rivers, expressways and the sprawling Tuas and Jurong estates make walking routes longer than the crow flies. Feeder buses are the real access mode for many residents, and their routes are not modelled, only the bus stop count, and that count turned out to carry no signal. A station’s attractiveness does not include frequency, crowding or fares. Rail times in the graph assume uniform speeds.

Scope of the prediction. Tap-ins exclude transfers, so these are not line ridership figures. They cannot be compared with LTA’s estimate of more than 600,000 daily riders on the whole Cross Island Line (Land Transport Authority, 2026b), which covers more phases and counts differently. Stations outside the brief’s scope, such as Cross Island Line Phase 2, change the picture later, particularly around Jurong East and Clementi.

Inference. Bootstrap intervals treat stations as independent, and residuals are weakly clustered (§7), so intervals are somewhat too narrow. The hold-out exercise tests lines in a network that already exists, and a new line’s competitive position may differ. The maximum access distance was chosen partly on plausibility rather than on a score, which is a judgement and is shown as one. At the low end, the model overpredicts stations with very few riders, so a station’s risk of low ridership is more likely understated.

是截面，不是变化。 一切都基于同一网络的两个月数据。模型说的是零售更多的车站乘客更多，而不是增加零售就会增加乘客；新线对既有车站的影响是由今天车站之间的竞争推断的，并未被观测到。DataMall 只保留最近三个月的数据，所以无法用此前的任何一次开通来检验这一预测。

土地利用是当前的。 拟建车站的吸引力变量描述的是那里现在的情况。登加与裕廊创新区将会改变，随新住宅而来的商店与公交服务并未被建模。正如 Buangkok 所示，客流最终可能与车站开放时的周边情况几乎无关。

需求是间接测量的。 居民数据截至 2024 年 6 月，此后的 HDB 组屋为估计值。统计只涵盖公民与永久居民，其他非居民未计入；宿舍字段只覆盖住在 OSM 标记为宿舍的建筑中的人。工作场所占地没有高度，所以 CBD 被低估，OSM 的测绘也因地而异。客流的早高峰拆分是一种代理指标，活动端衰减估计较弱正反映了这一点。

距离是直线。 河流、高速公路以及大片的大士与裕廊工业区使步行路线比直线更长。接驳公交是许多居民真正的到达方式，其线路未被建模，只有公交站数量，而这一数量并没有带来信号。车站吸引力不包括班次、拥挤或票价。网络图中的轨道时间假定速度一致。

预测的范围。 进站量不包括换乘，所以这些不是线路客流数字，不能与 LTA 对整条跨岛线每日超过 600,000 人次的估计比较 (Land Transport Authority, 2026b)，后者涵盖更多阶段，统计口径也不同。题目范围之外的车站，如跨岛线第二期，之后会改变这一图景，尤其是 Jurong East 与 Clementi 一带。

推断。 自助法区间假定车站相互独立，而残差存在微弱聚集（§7），所以区间略显偏窄。留出检验测试的是已存在网络中的线路，新线的竞争地位可能不同。最大到达距离的选择部分基于合理性而非分数，这是一种判断，也如实呈现为判断。在低端，模型高估了乘客极少的车站，所以车站的低客流风险更可能被低估。

The exercise is a self-contained folder inside the course’s Quarto website. Every path in the scripts and the report is relative to take-home-ex/take-home-ex3/, and the scripts are run from there. The report renders from data/derived/ alone, so the steps below are only needed to rebuild the analysis.

From an empty cache, 05_calibrate.R is the slowest, at more than ten minutes on a 16-core desktop with 8 worker processes. The scripts with random draws set set.seed(1234), and the parallel draws set their own fixed seeds, so results are identical on rerun. data/cache/ holds the slow results and can be deleted to force recomputation.

Of the data, the raw volumes, the HDB footprints and the OSM extract are not committed, because of size; the aggregated results the report reads are.
